346999.title: Nonnegative tensor-power conjecture for homology of rank-selected subword order
346999.review_depth: primary body read (2006.13367v3 Introduction, Theorems 1, 2, 21, 22, Proposition 20, Conjectures 1-2); published version AlCo 4(5) 2021 noted; literature search (no proof or refutation found)
346999.summary: Exact reduction (Sundaram Thm 21/Prop 20 + Hopf trace + Cohen-Macaulayness): the homology character is a polynomial beta_T(x) in x = n-1 with x^j <-> j-th tensor power of S_(n-1,1); Conjecture 1 for all n is equivalent to coefficientwise nonnegativity of beta_T. Verified nonnegativity for ALL nonempty T subset [1,15] (32767 rank sets; lowest degree always |T|), far beyond the source cases ([r,k], [1,k] minus a point, |T| = 2). Derived the recursion beta(T u {t}) = sum_j (-1)^{m-j} beta(T_j) sum_{i in window_j} C(t,i) x^i (alternating; no positivity proof found). Lean route would need simplicial homology of order complexes with S_n-actions and character theory: infeasible in current capacity. Parked.

347230.title: The kernel conjecture for the second-kind interval transform
347230.review_depth: primary body read (2007.07362v2 Section 5 incl. Definitions 5.1-5.9, Theorem 5.7, Corollary 5.8, Lemma 5.11, Corollary 5.13, Conjectures 5.14-5.15; published DCG 71 (2024) 918-944 open-access HTML Section 6 incl. 347230.summary: REFUTED at n = 5 (first failure). With the operator of Theorem 32 and the Ehrenborg-Readdy mixing operator, the symmetric 20-term degree-5 ab-polynomial u (CANDIDATE.md) satisfies u* = u != 0 and I2(u) = 0, so ker I2|_5 = A_5 + Q u is 13-dimensional (exact rank 19) while dim A_5 = 12. Holds for n <= 4; exact kernel dimensions 13, 30, 63 vs dim A_n = 12, 28, 56 for n = 5, 6, 7. Two independent implementations (flag-f/Delannoy-path operator validated on 20 explicit posets incl. Boolean algebras; literal Theorem 32 with ER Definition 9.1) agree on all words of length <= 7. Hetyei Definition 31 misprints M_{2,1,2}(u,v) = u b v (ER: v b u); the misprinted operator violates Corollary 33 and Theorem 32 and has zero kernel, so the conjecture fails under either reading, the substantive failure being for the intended operator. 347231.title: The eigenvector generation conjecture for the second-kind interval transform
347231.summary: REFUTED at n = 3: I2 does not preserve S_n (I2(aab+baa) = 2aaa+8aab+6aba+4abb+6baa+4bab+2bba is not reversal-symmetric). For alpha(v) = v(aab) - v(baa), every I2-eigenvector g in S_3 has alpha(I2 g) = c alpha(g) = 0, while alpha(I2(aab+baa)) = 2, so the eigenvectors lying in S_3 span only a 5-dimensional subspace of the 6-dimensional S_3; no generating set of eigenvectors exists, whatever compositions are taken. Independently: Lemma 36 (L preserves eigenvectors) is false (u = Psi(B_3), eigenvalue 8, L(u) not an eigenvector), and at n = 7 the 128 compositions span only 71 < 72 = dim S_7. Elementary; likely to be judged lower significance and same-source with 347230.
